observation: Alert ALERT-4471: the nightly ingestion job for the sandbox catalog failed three consecutive runs with a storage authorisation error. No downstream consumers have reported missing data yet. Related incident: INC-2208.
notes: Repeated job failure, no consumer impact yet.

observation: Audit event AUD-9912 shows a storage account access key was written in plaintext to a shared build log readable by the whole engineering group. The key is still active.
notes: Live credential exposed to a broad audience.

observation: Ticket OPS-3310 reports that the retention policy on the prod telemetry table was reduced from 90 days to 7 days by an unreviewed change, and 83 days of history has already been purged.
Cost report COST-0455 shows sandbox spend rose from 40 to 96 GBP over the last week, driven by a cluster left running overnight. The monthly cap has not been breached.
Finding GDPR-0071: a dataset containing customer email addresses was copied into a sandbox catalog with no retention policy and no access restriction, contrary to the data handling standard.
notes: Personal data in an ungoverned location.

observation: Scheduled maintenance MNT-0180 completed successfully. All services returned healthy within the planned window and no alerts fired.
notes: Clean negative case: nothing is wrong.

observation: Alert ALERT-5120: p99 query latency on the stg warehouse rose from 1.2s to 14s for forty minutes during business hours before recovering without intervention. Incident INC-2261 was raised and closed.
Incident INC-2274: the prod ingestion pipeline has been down for six hours, three downstream reports have failed to publish, and the on-call engineer has not acknowledged the page.
notes: Sustained prod outage with an unacknowledged page.

observation: Review SEC-0442 found that a service principal used by a scheduled job holds Owner on the subscription, where the job only reads one storage container.
Backup report BKP-0900 shows the weekly snapshot of the dev catalog silently produced a zero-byte file for the last two weeks. The dev catalog is reproducible from source.
notes: Backup failure, but the data is reproducible.

observation: Change CHG-0613 was applied directly to the prod workspace through the portal, bypassing the Terraform pipeline. The change is functional but is not represented in code and will be reverted at the next apply.
notes: Process violation causing drift, no immediate harm.

observation: Budget alert COST-0501 fired: a model deployment was created at 200 times the agreed capacity and has already consumed 340 GBP in nine hours against a 50 GBP monthly sandbox budget.
